jit.name: Just-In-Time (JIT)
jit.description: Pull-based signaling system (Kanban) that eliminates over-processing waste (Muda).
jit.mechanism: Hooks are only pulled for execution when a delta matching their signaling condition enters the line.

jidoka.name: Jidoka (Autonomation)
jidoka.description: Quality at the source via error-proofing (Poka-yoke) and failure signaling (Andon).
jidoka.mechanism: Immediately stops the production line (Line Stop) when an abnormal condition or law violation is detected.

heijunka.name: Heijunka (Leveling)
heijunka.description: Levels the production volume and mix to prevent overburden (Muri) and unevenness (Mura).
heijunka.mechanism: Batches and intervals hook execution to maintain a steady flow and respect system capacity.

kaizen.name: Kaizen (Continuous Improvement)
kaizen.description: The 'Refining Engine' that analyzes execution history to suggest optimizations.
kaizen.mechanism: Analyzes receipts to identify redundant hooks and suggests tighter predicates for JIT efficiency.
